# Montana Fly Fishing Lodge (concept spec by Kerblabs, not endorsed)

> Three Montana fly fishing lodges near Absarokee offering guided drift, raft and walk and wade trips. Facts below come from montanaflyfishinglodge.com.

## Facts
- Address: 6 Running River Way, Absarokee, MT 59001
- Phone: (406) 608-8886; text (406) 625-0482
- Email: lincoln@montanaflyfishinglodge.com
- Lodges: Flagship Lodge (East Rosebud Creek, all-inclusive), Spring Creek Lodge (private spring creek), Bighorn River Lodge (near Fort Smith)
- Rivers: Yellowstone, Bighorn, Stillwater, Boulder, Shoshone, East Rosebud Creek, West Rosebud Creek, Rock Creek, Clark Fork of the Yellowstone, Upper Yellowstone, private spring creeks
- Packages: N nights / N-1 fishing days (3/2 to 7/6) or custom
- Prices: not published; contact the lodge
- Terms listed: 50% deposit, balance 90 days before arrival

## Contact route
mailto:lincoln@montanaflyfishinglodge.com
